title: Zeugenaufruf zum Fall der seit 2000 vermissten Sandra Wißmann

extraction.summaryEn: A 12-year-old girl disappeared on 28 November 2000 after leaving her home and being last seen near the Kottbusser Damm; the 5th Homicide Commission treats the case as a capital crime. Police and prosecutors issued a public appeal for witnesses on the 25th anniversary of the missing children day.
